name: British Council LearnEnglish Teens
description_short: A free British Council hub of reading, writing, listening, grammar and vocabulary practice for teenage English learners, organised by skill and level.
creator: British Council
internal_notes: age_group set to teen (specific) — the site itself states it is built for 13-17 year olds, a genuine, sourced claim rather than a guess. cefr_level left unknown rather than guessed: materials are organised by CEFR level site-wide but span the full range with no single fixed level to record honestly, same treatment as iSLCollective. group_fit and teaching_use left unassessed/empty for the same broad-hub reason as iSLCollective: this is homework/self-study-oriented material a teacher assigns or browses, not a single activity with one assessable skill or group format.
